newsitem.title: USA: Jordan seeks 120,000 T U.S. wheat - agent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks 120,000 T U.S. wheat - agent.

text.p: Jordan will seek a total of about 120,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat and/or northern spring/dark northern spring wheat on May 1, under the PL-480, title I export program, its U.S. agent said.
The wheat was divided into two shipments of 30,000 to 60,000 tonnes each. One lot was slated for May 12-27 and the other for June 15-30.
The wheat would be in bulk, with maximum value not to exceed $21 million.
Offers are to be received no later than May 1 and remain firm through May 2, the agent said.
